description: This file defines configuration options and a validator class for MemoryGrainStorage in the Orleans framework. It includes classes 'MemoryGrainStorageOptions' for storing configuration parameters and 'MemoryGrainStorageOptionsValidator' for validating those parameters.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for MemoryGrainStorage, including the number of storage grains, initialization stage, and serializer.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the provided MemoryGrainStorageOptions instance according to specified rules.

methods.name: MemoryGrainStorageOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the validator with options and a name.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation on the options; throws exceptions if validation rules are not met.
